questions.q: What does lowering SiK AIR_SPEED from 64 to 16 kbit/s give you?
options: Nothing: range depends only on transmitter power
About 6 dB and roughly twice the range
Four times faster mission upload
Lower latency in the control channel
questions.explain: Sensitivity improves by ~3 dB for every halving; 6 dB means twice the range.

questions.q: Which parameters must match within a SiK pair?
options: Only TXPOWER
Only SERIAL_SPEED and TXPOWER on both modem ends
Serial numbers and bootloader versions
NETID, AIR_SPEED, ECC, frequencies and channels
questions.explain: Otherwise the modems won't link; SERIAL_SPEED is the UART baud rate on each modem's own side.

questions.q: What is the SiK parameter MAVLINK = 1 for?
options: Injecting RADIO_STATUS and aligning packets
Encrypting MAVLink traffic
Switching the modem to the legacy MAVLink 1 protocol
Prioritizing the video stream over telemetry
questions.explain: The modem aligns packets to MAVLink and injects RADIO_STATUS; ArduPilot adjusts its streams based on txbuf.

questions.q: RSSI = 190, noise = 60. What is the fade margin, approximately?
options: 130 dB
32 dB
65 dB
6 dB

questions.q: How much does range grow with +12 dB of margin?
options: Twofold
12 times
By 12 %
Fourfold
questions.explain: Every 6 dB doubles it: 12 dB gives ×4.

questions.q: Why is ECC on SiK not recommended?
options: It is incompatible with MAVLink 2
It halves the useful data rate and doesn't work on some chips
It is banned by radio regulations in many countries
It requires a separate wire to the flight controller
questions.explain: Golay coding doubles the transmitted data; some newer radio chips don't support it and won't work with ECC = 1.

questions.q: What are IP radios/mesh for, rather than SiK?
options: For the cheapest and simplest telemetry at 1–2 km
For flights within 500 m only
Video, SSH and several vehicles on one network
For replacing a 2.4 GHz RC receiver
questions.explain: An IP radio is an Ethernet bridge: MAVLink over UDP, video, access to the companion, a fleet.

questions.q: The main risk of LTE telemetry?
options: Coverage dropouts and latency, NAT
Too high a channel data rate
MAVLink can't be sent over IP
Very short range in the city
questions.explain: You need a VPN or a relay and a mandatory link-loss failsafe.
